title: Fleet Reaper Phase 3 — chat-capacity upgrades (live-chat boost + bg-app throttle + per-chat advisory + reaper self-IO)
description: Strictly additive over FLEET-REAPER-MS0/MS1/MS2. Reframes the reaper from 'kill more orphans / save more memory' to 'keep live chats at full capacity.' Reaper today does nothing for the failure mode of 13 live non-orphaned chats fighting for the same CPU/RAM/disk — host runs at 96% commit pressure with zero orphans, yet every chat is slow. MS3 adds four strictly-reversible, kill-switched units: (A) UserPromptSubmit hook boosts the active chat's claude.exe tree to AboveNormal for 5 min; (B) Tier-1.5 background-app throttling under warn-band pressure drops Chrome/Discord/Steam to BelowNormal before any reap; (C) fleet-memory-monitor posts a per-chat /compact advisory when a single tree exceeds 2 GB RSS (before system-wide critical); (D) reaper-self drops to PROCESS_MODE_BACKGROUND_BEGIN during sweeps so its own I/O doesn't compete with Claude for disk. Every unit honors PRISM_FR_DISABLE=1 master kill + per-unit knob.
goals: Give the chat the user is actively typing in a measurable CPU lift via AboveNormal priority on its claude.exe + node.exe tree for 5 min (auto-decays)
Convert non-Claude tree RSS into Claude headroom under warn-band pressure via reversible BelowNormal throttle on top-3 heavy non-system processes (hysteresis: down at 90%, up at 85%)
Tell the chat that is bloating to /compact BEFORE system-wide critical via per-chat-tree threshold advisory in fleet-memory-monitor
Remove the reaper's own 30s sweep from Claude's disk-queue critical path via PROCESS_MODE_BACKGROUND_BEGIN wrapper
